caption:
Binge-watching over the break? Your back would like an intermission. 📺

There's no perfect way to sit on the couch, and slouching isn't harmful in itself. What tends to stiffen backs is staying in one shape for hours.

Try Hybi's 1-minute intermission every 30 to 45 minutes: stand up, walk to the kitchen, reach overhead and do 5 gentle back bends. A cushion behind your lower back helps, and so does balancing couch days with a morning walk or swim.

Pain that wakes you at night, numbness around the groin, bladder or bowel changes or leg weakness need a prompt GP check.

If the stiffness hangs around into the new year, our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio.
